title: Daytrading with Claude?
author: Saviourofme
selftext:

Ive seen lots of people using Claude and saying that they made a bot or use it to analyze charts but what do I need to do that?

Well I have a Claude pro subscribtion so that wont be a problem but my goal is to use Claude to learn about Daytrading and to analyze charts. Can someone help me?

comments.author: bigpapadre229
comments.body:
The only way I’ve really found a way to use Claude to trade is if you’re sharing (screenshot) your current chart markup and your analysis, and tell Claude to analysis and report back on their end

I have built an indicator for both MT5 (Metatrader) & TradingView but not a bot. Even then building the indicators you can’t get too technical with it 

I basically had Claude make a indicator based on my trading style and preferences

comments.author: Good_Character_20
comments.body: For learning, Claude's genuinely good and that's the use I'd lean into hardest. Paste a concept you only half get, ask it to explain where the setup works and where it breaks down, then have it quiz you on the same thing a few days later. That compounds fast when you're starting out. Chart analysis is where I'd be careful. It can read a screenshot and describe support, resistance, a pattern, but it has no live data and no idea what happened after the candle you showed it, so it'll narrate confident levels that mean nothing going forward. Good for training your eye on structure, not something to trade off of. And the bots you've seen are usually Claude writing backtest code you run yourself, not Claude placing the trades.
